proposals.title: Prune duplicate QA slot startup witnesses while retaining native ownership and evidence isolation
proposals.sourceCause: run-scenario-slots.test.mjs reopens real contained launchers and native locks for each port-table row and for two overlapping same-label namespace scenarios. Current source 65500 row takes exactly the same requestedFits=false route for both held slots as retained 5374. A separate two-session same-label test is subsumed by the stronger legacy-root/game-log test when its owned-log and live-child observations are carried forward. This is contract pruning, not OS querying, process containment, locking, or provider behavior work.

exactAreas.bodies: 397 port-row literal: remove only [65500,[5174,5274]];457–468 weaker same-label namespace case and470–489 stronger legacy-root/game-log case: subsume weaker observables into stronger retained case. Keep all mocks, cleanup, remaining port rows and other tests.
Own evidence and exact observation/deletion map.

proposals.implementation: Delete only the 65500 table row. Retain 5174,5274,5374,5175,5275 with both simultaneous live slots and their exact expected selected ports. Consolidate the weaker same-label namespace case into the existing stronger legacy-root/game-log case: retain distinct captureDir and invocation paths, both contained server processes live, nonempty per-session server-log bytes preserved while the peer runs, distinct saved game-log paths, original legacy-root bytes, and distinct result/image payload paths. Keep actual native server/lease startup, all resource cleanup, and concurrent session.runPlan calls. If the owned-log sentinel needs first-session-before-second-start setup, use that setup inside this one retained case; the retained 5174 port case continues to witness two concurrent same-checkout startups with serialized spawn/ready ordering. Do not substitute mocks for the real launcher/lock boundary.

The initial weak case has no unique provider failure or native ownership transition.

5174 queued reopen + occupied-port refusal + peer byte/lock liveness; uncertain-provider/server-settlement failures; native owned runner SIGTERM; quarantine peer isolation; foreign listener rejection; all per-file teardown and no surviving direct children.
